title: Fridge shortlist: fit first, then cost and quiet
description: A synthetic but realistic appliance comparison that makes kitchen constraints and rejected models explicit.
content: Synthetic refrigerator comparison with kitchen constraints, fit gates, installed costs, recommendation, alternative, and provenance.

blocks.title: Kitchen constraints are the first filter
Shortlist: visual, name, and decision stay together
Nordhaven 430 Graphite
blocks.summary: 430 L · 59.5 × 185 × 64 cm · 38 dB · energy class B
blocks.content: The quietest qualifying model with enough capacity and a clean door-clearance margin. Installed cost: **31,780 Kč**.

media.alt: Illustration of the graphite Nordhaven 430 refrigerator with two doors and a B energy label
media.credit: Cognis local fixture · original SVG product illustration

blocks.title: Harbor 390 Cream
blocks.summary: 390 L · 59.5 × 186 × 65 cm · 39 dB · energy class C
blocks.content: Saves **4,700 Kč** installed. It gives up 40 L and uses more electricity, but still meets the hard constraints.

media.alt: Illustration of the cream Harbor 390 refrigerator with a lower freezer door and a C energy label
media.credit: Cognis local fixture · original SVG product illustration

blocks.title: Nordhaven 430 Graphite
blocks.summary: Pay the premium for quieter operation, extra capacity, lower energy use, and two more warranty years.
blocks.content: Order only after the installer confirms the measured 640 mm depth clearance.

blocks.title: Harbor 390 Cream
blocks.summary: Choose this model when the 4,700 Kč saving matters more than capacity and energy class.
blocks.content: It is a valid fit, not a compromise on the hard constraints.

blocks.title: Before ordering
blocks.content: Measure the deepest hinge point and the door swing again. The fixture recommendation assumes 8 mm side clearance and 20 mm rear ventilation.
